name: Eliel
title: Warrior in David's army
summary: Eliel is a name that appears several times in the Old Testament and refers to various individuals. The most well-known Eliel was one of David's brave warriors and military leaders. The name means 'My God is God' and is borne by several Levites, tribal chiefs, and military commanders in biblical texts.

keyEvents.title: Eliel among David's heroes
keyEvents.description: Eliel from Mahavim is mentioned among David's mighty warriors who served him faithfully.

keyEvents.title: Eliel as a Gadite warrior
keyEvents.description: One Eliel was among the Gadite warriors who joined David in the wilderness, known for his bravery and combat skills.

keyEvents.title: Eliel as a Levite under David
keyEvents.description: One Eliel was among the Levites appointed to help move the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem during King David's reign.

keyEvents.title: Eliel as overseer in the temple
keyEvents.description: During King Hezekiah's religious reforms, an Eliel served as overseer over the offerings and tithes in the house of the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Eliel in the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: An Eliel is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin as one of the tribal leaders.

keyEvents.title: Eliel as a descendant of Reuben
keyEvents.description: An Eliel is mentioned among the heads of the tribe of Reuben in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles.
